rules: primitive progress indicators are not defects
raw UV atlases are not finished cards

coverage.record_scope_note: 62 is the mapped entry/mode count, not a claim that 62 records received complete contextual visual audit; each entry carries PASS, FAIL, or UNVERIFIED.
known_omissions: Native contextual-scale capture was not available for fetch, dolls, shop, treasure, dance, kart, standalone combat, comfy hide-and-seek, and Ember/Dungeon presenters; those groups are UNVERIFIED rather than inferred failures.
SVG and some dynamic sprite atlases were source/hash mapped but not raster-viewed in this pass.

The inspected source directly loaded assets/mg/wateringcan.png. Root reports the art35 flat silhouette candidate was rejected and a separate native-alpha candidate is being integrated; verify that current redirect in the isolated checkout before any repair assignment.

global_findings.finding: DungeonArt fallback map is empty for both themes and exposes raw UV maps across 16 active rooms.
Dust boss tell directory is stale/missing while approved boss atlases live in assets/sprites/dust_bunnies/boss.
Garden pot and trampoline are confirmed underconstructed code-native objects despite valid interaction geometry.
Watering-can crop was fixed by root in snapshot 022ce0ba/rootcoverage; this audit retains the original hash and asks only for isolated-checkout verification of the new art35 silhouette.

repair_policy: No runtime, canonical, protected, or git asset was edited during this audit. Root assigns one bounded job at a time after contextual review; every new asset needs provenance and ASSET_LICENSES.md entry.
